description: A middle-aged man with long wavy dark hair and a full beard leans his head against a pine tree, eyes closed with a furrowed brow. He wears a blue and brown plaid flannel shirt with sleeves rolled up, his right arm wrapped around the rough, peeling bark of the tree trunk.
title: Man Embracing Pine Tree
prompt: A rugged man in his 30s with long curly dark hair, thick beard and intense expression, eyes closed and brow furrowed, pressing his face and body against a pine tree trunk in an outdoor forest setting. He wears a blue and brown plaid flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, right arm wrapped around the tree. Warm golden hour sunlight filters through pine branches above, creating soft highlights on his hair and shoulders. Rough peeling bark texture on the pine tree, natural forest background with pine needles visible. Cinematic realistic photography, moody and contemplative atmosphere, earthy tones, shot on 35mm film
